title: Traversal
statement:
To **traverse** an array, visit each element from index **0** to **n − 1**.

Read **n** and the array. Print all elements **space-separated** on one line.
ioRules:
- Line 1: **n**
- Line 2: **n** integers
- Output: all elements separated by single spaces, no trailing space

examples.explanation: Visit each element left to right.
